title: Attracting Polytechnic Graduates to Work in Banking and Finance Sector and Take-up of Places in Apprenticeship Programmes for Them
what_it_is: Attracting Polytechnic Graduates to Work in Banking and Finance Sector and Take-up of Places in Apprenticeship Programmes for Them

sections.label: MAS polytechnic graduate hiring target
sections.summary: MAS targets raising polytechnic graduates entering full-time permanent financial sector jobs from about 160 in 2021 to at least 300 by 2025, with the Apprenticeship Track contributing the bulk.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS targets to increase the number of polytechnic graduates who take on full-time permanent jobs in the financial sector by more than 80%, from about 160 entering the sector in 2021 to at least 300 by 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: While the financial sector already offers many internships to polytechnic students, there are much fewer apprenticeship programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: MAS aims for the Apprenticeship Track to contribute the bulk of the target increase in the number of polytechnic graduates in the sector, or rather entering the sector.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: After polytechnic graduates join the financial sector, they can tap upskilling opportunities available to all financial sector professionals under MAS’ Talent and Leaders in Finance Programme.

sections.label: Polytechnic Talent for Finance apprenticeship track
sections.summary: The apprenticeship track aims to correct the misperception that a university degree is a prerequisite for good financial sector jobs, incentivising institutions to place apprentices in graduate-equivalent roles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: With the roll-out of this scheme, the Polytechnic Talent for Finance apprenticeship track, we hope to correct this misperception that a university degree is a prerequisite for a good job and a career progression in the financial services sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: This apprenticeship track incentivises financial institutions to develop these kinds of apprenticeship programmes that provide a clear path for deserving apprentices to be placed in university graduate-equivalent roles upon completion.

sections.label: Outreach and campus sharing sessions
sections.summary: MAS plans coordinated outreach such as career fairs and industry showcases, and is exploring finance professionals holding regular campus sharing sessions to raise students' awareness and interest.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In addition, we are also going to make sure that there are going to be coordinated outreach efforts, such as career fairs and financial industry showcases to raise awareness and increase indeed, the students' awareness and interest in the financial sector.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: MAS is also exploring having finance professionals conduct regular sharing sessions on campus to increase students' understanding of developments and to work in the sector.
